title: Built, with no users: what we did instead of launching.
description: AdoptDontShop is built and has no users. Before the beta, we spent weeks on security and reliability fixes. Here is what the dated changelog shows.
lede: AdoptDontShop is built and has no users. Here is what we did instead of launching: weeks of fixes to security and reliability, all in a public changelog.
summary: No rescue has used AdoptDontShop yet. Before the closed beta we fixed missing permission checks, hashed invitation tokens, tightened uploads and added a production smoke test.
